test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 17 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: 18 men can complete a work in 50 days, If 25 men are employed, then in how many days the work will be completed?
solution:
**Given:**

Men = 18

Time = 50 days

**Formula used:**

Work = Number of days (Time) (T or D) × Number of men (M). 

M1 × D1 = M2 × D2

**Calculation**

Let the number of days by 25 men to do the work be D2.

⇒ 18 × 50 = 25 × D2

⇒ D2 = 900\25

⇒ D2 = 36 days

**∴ Number of days is 36.**
